package.name: house_cleaner_battery
package.description:
Battery telemetry for the house cleaner robot. Two interchangeable backends publish the same ``/battery_state`` topic and the same ``/dock/command`` (as /dock/state) contract:
* ``battery_sim`` — drains while driving, charges while docked * ``battery_hw`` — real TurtleBot3 dock with current sensing
The mission supervisor only ever talks to ``/battery_state`` and ``/dock/state``, so sim and real are swappable at launch time.
